entities.name: Walter Ivan de Azevedo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Walter Ivan de Azevedo was a Brazilian Roman Catholic prelate. He was bishop of São Gabriel da Cachoeira from 1988 to 2002. Azevedo died on 28 January 2024, at the age of 97.
